[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($407.46) vs SMA5/20/50($386.47/$374.31/$366.12): Short-term and mid-term trend confirmed bullish.
· SMA100/200($367.81/$385.94) comparison: Mid-to-long-term trend shows bullish dominance.
· 52-week position (54.6%) + Current price level indicates historical mid-range positioning.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (53.7 → 65.5): Confirmed exit from oversold and entry into overbought territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.1684 → 2.5961): Improving with continued bullish expansion, signaling trend continuation.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper Band $399.31): Breakout above upper band, band width at 13.36% expanding.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($393.63): Support established based on Pivot S1($366.08) and SMA200($385.94).
· Swing Resistance ($409.28): Breakout above resistance indicates potential for further upside.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Confirms continuation of the uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.02x): Normal volume levels maintain confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry conditions met, expecting further upside.
